reason: Mostly holds, but the '79d' part is overtaken by events. At 20:28Z, read-only kaggle kernels status showed: exp78b COMPLETE, exp79d already RUNNING, exp77 RUNNING, exp79a never pushed ('kernels.get denied'). The queue delay is specific to CI kernels, not a GPU concurrency cap. Every kernel-metadata.json (exp72/75/76a/76d/76e/78a/78b/79a) is identical (T4, private, internet off, docker 37c64f7d) except for the dataset yuki0731/biohub-coord-inject. exp72 (pushed 13:27Z) and exp76d (~16:10Z) started at once while exp75 sat queued from 13:18Z to ~16:40Z. exp76a waited from 16:33Z to ~18:33Z while at most one other GPU kernel ran. With a 2.0-3.3 h queue and a ~32 min run, a push at ~20:35Z gives PASS at ~23:05-00:20Z (P(by 23:45Z) about 0.5). Waiting for 79d to finish (~20:55-21:00Z) gives ~23:30-00:45Z (P about 0.2-0.3). The gain is real but modest. The gate is sound: the exp70g dummy has 121,252 nodes / 81 forks, and CI moves only coordinates, so nodes and edges must equal exp70g's. The 23:45Z cutoff is only our rule, not a Kaggle one: a code-competition submit needs just a COMPLETE version. So the stronger fix is to pre-register a later CI slot. There is no rule problem: a private dummy under the 11:16Z aggressive directive, byte-identical off-path. Value caveat: CI's own private value is weak (in-sample 4-clip lab pooled +0.0022; the nearest transfer record went +0.0078 lab -> -0.002 LB). This is scheduling hygiene for a lever that is already approved, not new value.
fix: (1) Push the exp79a dummy NOW (vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp79a-k2cap6-coordinject, sha 5f9b265d); do not wait for exp79d, which is already running. If Kaggle refuses a 3rd concurrent GPU session, push again right after exp79d completes. Once it is QUEUED, never re-push it. (2) Gate: validate_csv ok; nodes == 121,252 and edge rows/forks == the exp70g dummy (81 forks); COORDINJECT SUMMARY videos=4/4, replaced ~0.915; 0 Traceback/FAILED/SKIPPED/DEADLINE:. (3) Pre-score, log one line amending R19-A1 (3)/v2 (4): 00:05Z = the SEC file (exp79d if PASS). The CI slot takes exp79a as soon as its dummy PASSES, up to 03:00Z 28 Sep (L ~9.7-10.5 h -> read ~13:30Z; if the CI ref is not terminal by then, CI = '?' for W2 as v2 (3) says). It falls back to exp76a, read against 0.954 with its own-base code, only if exp79a has not passed by 03:00Z.
realistic_gain: Scheduling only: P(the CI lever is tested on the 0.956 cap-6 base instead of the wrong-base exp76a) rises from ~0.2-0.3 to ~0.5 with the push alone, and to ~0.9 with the 03:00Z slot amendment. No direct score gain. CI's expected private effect is ~0 +/- 0.002.
